description.value: Pot Stickers 'n' Curry is a family-run Indo-Tibetan takeout restaurant in Campbell River, helmed by Chef Narayan, who brings 30 years of Asian cooking experience from across the world, and his wife Sama, who hand-rolls every potsticker and samosa from scratch. The menu spans Himalayan dumplings (momos and potstickers), chow mein, curries, noodle soups with house-made broth, and sides like garlic naan and samosas. It is a distinctive and affordable stop offering multiple vegan dishes alongside meat options.
